package.name: heading_align_critic
package.description:
DWB trajectory critic that penalizes trajectories whose end heading differs from the global path direction, and penalizes fast linear motion while turning. Useful for omnidirectional bases that should not drive sideways or backwards along a route.
Shipped as a standalone package so the stack can depend on the upstream (binary) dwb_critics instead of vendoring a patched copy of it.
